title: NFT Social Club
tagline: NFT Gated Content Sharing Platform that content creator can exclusively share their content to NFT holders.
description: NFT Social Club allows users to create text and image content and make them visible to only certain NFT holders. Content creator can choose any NFT project is Polygon network. Content viewers need to purchase that NFT to unlock the content. NFT Social Club platform check users wallet in real time and give permission to view content.
how_its_made: Frontend of the NFT Social Club is developed using ReactJS. NodeJS is used to develop the backend. MongoDB is used as the database of the project. Any NFT in the Polygon blockchain can be used as the gate to unlock the content. User authentication is done through metamask wallet connect. Avaliable NFTs for a user wallet is checked using Moralis web3 API and the content is unlocked according to avaliable NFTs in a user wallet.
